description.en-US: The 1947 English selection of John Eudes’s meditations: on prayer, for each day of the week, on the virtues, the Christian life and the priesthood.
description.pt-BR: A seleção inglesa de 1947 das meditações de João Eudes: sobre a oração, para cada dia da semana, sobre as virtudes, a vida cristã e o sacerdócio.

en-US.translator: unnamed translator (introduction by Charles Lebrun, C.J.M.)

sources.edition: Meditations on Various Subjects, translated by unnamed translator (introduction by Charles Lebrun, C.J.M.), New York, P. J. Kenedy & Sons, 1947. Text layer of the Bibliothèque Saint Libère PDF (liberius.net), from the Eudist Fathers series, 1946–48.
sources.description: Converted by script: running heads and page numbers removed, paragraphs rejoined, hyphenation repaired. The OCR of the PDF text layer leaves some residual errors (for example 0 for O, rn for m); the translator’s introduction and notes are kept. The translation is not aligned chapter by chapter to the French edition, so it is a separate book.
sources.tierEvidence: Copyright 1946–48 P. J. Kenedy & Sons; no renewal in the Copyright Office records 1950–2001.
